name: nl.nltaxcalculator/salary-sg
title: Singapore Salary and Income Tax Calculator
description: Singapore 2026: tax return estimate, net salary, gross for net, employer cost, vs the Netherlands

tools.name: net_salary
tools.description: Take-home pay for an employee in Singapore from a gross yearly salary in SGD, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: Resident progressive rates 0% to 24% (YA 2024 onwards); CPF for citizens and PRs by age, first and second year PR graduated rates, none for foreigners; Monthly Ordinary Wage ceiling S$8,000 and S$102,000 annual ceiling; Earned income, CPF, spouse, child and parent reliefs under the S$80,000 cap; Non-resident employment tax: the higher of 15% and the resident rates.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in SGD, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

status.description: CPF status. CPF is compulsory for citizens and permanent residents only.: citizen = Citizen, or PR from the 3rd year; pr1 = PR, 1st year (graduated rates); pr2 = PR, 2nd year (graduated rates); foreigner = Foreigner (no CPF). Default citizen.

residence.description: Tax residence. Non-residents get no personal reliefs and pay at least 15% on employment income.: resident = Tax resident (183 days or more); nonresident = Non-resident. Default resident.

parents_living.description: Parents living with you (Parent Relief). S$9,000 per dependent parent who lives with you; IRAS sets conditions on the age and income of the parent.. Default 0.

parents_apart.description: Parents supported but living apart. S$5,500 per dependent parent you support but who lives apart, under the same IRAS conditions.. Default 0.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many SGD, for the euro amounts. Default 1.5 (indicative).

tools.name: tax_rules_covered
tools.description: The Singapore rules the calculators apply (2026), the options they take, what is not modelled, and the official sources, for the salary calculators and the full income tax return. Call it before answering a question the other tools may not cover.

tools.name: income_tax_return
tools.description: The complete Singapore income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Resident progressive rates 0% to 24% (Year of Assessment 2024 onwards) on 2026 income; Employment, sole-proprietor and rental income; no capital gains tax; the S$80,000 relief cap; Earned income, CPF, spouse, child, parent, SRS, CPF cash top-up and donation (250%) reliefs; Employee CPF by age and status with the S$8,000 monthly and S$102,000 annual ceilings; Non-residents: the higher of 15% flat and the resident rates, 24% on other income, the 60-day exemption; Tax already paid and the balance; no withholding on salary. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in SGD; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

tools.name: cross_border_year
tools.description: Estimates the employment income tax in BOTH countries for the tax year in which someone moves from one country to another: residency status in each country by its own rules (India's 182-day financial-year test, US substantial presence and dual-status, UK split year, Dutch migration year, German part-year liability), the income each country taxes, tax before and after relief for tax paid abroad, social contributions, the combined total in euros and a comparison with staying. Covers 19 countries; each country is taxed for its own tax year containing the move date. Returns what is not covered, assumptions, and for researched corridors (India with the Netherlands, US, UK or Germany; Netherlands with Germany or the UK) the forms and deadlines, treaty notes and official sources. Salaries are full-year rates in each country's own currency.

direction.description: moving_from_here: you leave Singapore for the other country; moving_to_here: you arrive in Singapore from the other country

salary_after_move.description: Yearly salary rate in the country you move to, in its currency

indian_citizen.description: India: you are an Indian citizen (default true)
